antigens.source_commit: 22834cf FIX: Raise an error for duplicate keys in inline tables
antigens.title: Duplicate key silently overwrites
antigens.pattern: assigning into a table without first checking the key is already defined

antigens.source_commit: 7094082 FIX: No error was raised when defining a table in a frozen namespace
antigens.title: Frozen namespace not enforced
antigens.pattern: a code path that creates/extends a table without checking the namespace is frozen (inline tables/arrays are immutable)

antigens.title: Internal exception leaks instead of TOMLDecodeError
antigens.pattern: an internal KeyError/ValueError escapes to the caller instead of being converted to TOMLDecodeError

antigens.source_commit: 91df038 FIX: Raise if escaped Unicode character is not a Unicode scalar value (#27)
antigens.title: Invalid Unicode escape accepted
antigens.pattern: escaped code points validated only for range, not for surrogates (not a Unicode scalar value)

antigens.source_commit: 9e56735 Error when dotted keys define values outside current table (#125)
antigens.title: Dotted-key namespace flags not finalised
antigens.pattern: flags for namespaces opened by dotted keys never applied, so later table headers can redefine them

antigens.source_commit: e1fdb94 Limit number of parts of a key (#286)
antigens.title: Unbounded key depth
antigens.pattern: no limit on the number of dotted key parts (quadratic blow-up on hostile input)
